phone.cc.archetype: international dialling code of the residence market; code-only in v5 (HM_PH phone-detector regexes)

notes: count = occurrences in the v5 dictionary EN + AR (plus stray HTML text for advisor full names/initials, and a fixed JS count where the entity is JS-only). keys = up to 8 dictionary keys; 'stray:<screen>' = literal HTML text; 'js:<symbol>' = hard-coded in JS (not tokenizable by dictionary tokenizers).

Scope choices: res.tz is RESIDENCE on purpose (session times are shown in the viewer's local time; cross-market personas X-EG-GCC, X-JO-AE, X-IN-GCC, X-MA-FR live elsewhere than they target). gov.taxes/gov.natid/gov.iqama are TARGET on purpose (they describe the employer's country), so they are not under tax./legal. (residence). Possible overlap with partition ids like legal.iqama / legal.national_id / tax.* : dedupe in favour of these target-scope gov.* ids.

Tricky (AR): 'السعودية' is 4 different things. Country noun -> {@ctry.n}. Feminine adjective after a noun (اللجان السعودية، مدينة سعودية، فرق الموارد البشرية السعودية) -> ال{@ctry.demf} / {@ctry.demf}. Saudia airline (swh5Co, 'الخطوط السعودية' swh5About, 'وحدات أعمال السعودية' swh5Role) -> co.* (other partition), never ctry. Inside proper names (الهيئة السعودية للمراجعين = SOCPA, البنك المركزي السعودي = SAMA, البنك الأهلي السعودي = SNB in cvtBaRole/cvtPrevRowS) -> part of cert./gov./co. ids, never ctry.

Tricky (AR): 'الرياض' inside 'بنك الرياض' (Riyad Bank: swh1Co, swh1About, qaCoRb, mq1b4, qaLogS, qaW2a, qaQ2c) is co.*, not city.riyadh; 'والرياضة' (sports, swc5About) is a plain word. 'المدينة' alone = 'the city' (pfCity, cAddBtn, tCityAdded...) never city.medina. 'الخبر' in mlAfterConfirm = 'the news', not Al Khobar. 'جاهز'/'وجده'/'أسماء'/'يزيد' also appear as common words (mgNote*, lensAdvisorsList).

Tricky (AR orthography): ل + a value starting with ال contracts to لل (v5: 'للمنطقة الشرقية' swc3O1, 'للمملكة' swh5About). 'ل{@city.eastprov}' would expand to 'لالمنطقة' and fail verify. Recommend MKT.expand collapse 'لال' -> 'لل' at a token boundary (and tokenizers write ل{@id}); otherwise use the escape hatch {@city.eastprov|للمنطقة الشرقية} and accept the bare value elsewhere. Same for 'لليلى' (rpA3) which is fine (ل + ليلى, no ال).

Tricky (AR agreement): Arabic demonyms agree in gender and definiteness with the noun, not the persona: use ctry.dem (m) / ctry.demf (f) and attach ال literally (ال{@ctry.dem} works for إماراتي، بريطاني، مصري). Multi-word values (gov.natid 'الهوية الوطنية', prog.local 'التوطين', city.eastprov) already carry their ال: never prefix ال to them.

Tricky (EN): 'Saudia' (airline) contains 'Saudi'; regexes must use \bSaudi\b(?!a). EN uses one adjective form: every EN adjective 'Saudi' -> {@ctry.dem} (ctry.demf exists for AR/FR only). EN noun 'Saudi' (phHint2 'in Saudi', wr2s 'across Saudi and the Gulf', djSugE 'in Saudi') -> {@ctry.s}. EN possessive: {@ctry.n}'s ('the UK's' works).

Tricky (cross-language): the same key often uses different forms per language: swc9About/swh1About/swh4About/swh5About EN 'Saudi Arabia' vs AR 'المملكة' (EN {@ctry.n}, AR {@ctry.k}); cAllHint/djSugT EN adjective 'Saudi' vs AR noun 'السعودية' (EN {@ctry.dem}, AR {@ctry.n}); qaBQ3 EN 'Saudi Arabia' vs AR 'المملكة العربية السعودية' ({@ctry.full}); apNdBio EN 'GCC banks' vs AR 'بنوك الخليج' (EN {@reg.gcc}, AR {@reg.gulf}); pfVisaGcc EN 'GCC national' vs AR 'مواطن خليجي' ({@reg.natl} both). Tokenize each language independently.

Irregular spellings -> escape hatch: swh3City/swh3About/swh3O3 'Makkah' -> {@city.mecca|Makkah} (cMecca uses 'Mecca'); swh6Role 'KAEC' -> {@city.kaec|KAEC}; AR qaBQ3 could alternatively be {@ctry.n|المملكة العربية السعودية} if ctry.full is not wanted.

Persona city vs market city: these 'Riyadh' mentions are the persona's own work city and should be {@p.city} (persona partition), not {@city.riyadh}, because cross-market personas live in another city than they target: pfBioText (first mention), msaKnowList, msaMemItems ('Financial Analyst in Riyadh'), wr1s, swc3W1s, swc4W1s, swc7W1s, swc10W1s, hmDA1, hmAB1, qaD2c, and JS buildCV ('Riyadh, Saudi Arabia', 'Riyadh business units'). Search/targeting mentions (pfBioText 'role in Riyadh, Jeddah, or remote', pr2s, swSg1s, nt5s, cvrRaiseS, hrHiP, py1, jpAnchor, qaBO5a, city chips) stay {@city.*}. uni.ksu likewise = the persona's university ({@p.uni} if defined).

Not city.riyadh: rcSeller/rcSellerSara 'Uptal Information Technology Co, Riyadh' is Uptal's legal seat + Saudi 15-digit VAT number 300012345600003 -> needs a residence-scope legal entity id (legal.seller or similar: entity name, seat city, tax-ID label and number per billing entity), other partition.

Job-card cities are employer-bound: swc*City / swh*City and 'headquartered in X' in *About are the pack employer's HQ city. Mapping city.jeddah = cities[1] makes 'Saudia ... headquartered in Jeddah' wrong for markets whose airline is HQ'd elsewhere (GB: BA in London). Recommend the job-card/employer partition binds these to the employer (e.g. {@co.saudia.city}) or the pack employer list sets city ids consistent with these archetypes (Dhahran = energy HQ, Makkah = e-commerce HQ, KAEC = manufacturing plant, Ras Al Khair = mining site, Tabuk = giga-project).

Lists that should be generated, not tokenized: pfCo* (country picker: 8 hard-coded countries, SA default) and pfNat* (nationality picker; AR labels are feminine for the female persona, e.g. pfNatSA 'سعودية', pfNatGCC 'خليجية', pfNatEG 'مصرية'; tokens cannot nest inside {@g:..}, so a male persona cannot get 'سعودي'). Build both from base.json markets + pack.dem/arf with the persona gender. Same for the city chips cRiyadh..cAbha (= pack.cities) and suggestions cSugTabuk..cSugJubail (need a pack 'moreCities' list of 6), and qaBO5a-d (current base Riyadh/Jeddah/Dammam/Outside Saudi Arabia).

Work-rights option sets pfVisa*, qaBO3a-c are KSA taxonomy (Saudi national / Premium residency / Iqama transferable / not transferable / GCC national / needs visa). ctry.natl, reg.natl and gov.iqama keep KSA expansion exact, but for other markets the option list should come from pack.rights.opts. pfVisaPrem 'Premium residency'/'إقامة مميزة' is a Saudi-only programme: no registry id, replace via rights.opts.
ckBnplNote 'with your mobile number and ID' / 'برقم جوالك وهويتك' is BNPL KYC (payment, residence) -> pay.* partition, not gov.natid.

Not ids (brand/product constants per GLOSSARY): Musaed / مساعد (AI assistant), Uptal. 'the region' / 'المنطقة' (swc1About, swc4About, swc8Sum, swc8About) is generic and can stay literal. 'Remote' / 'عن بعد' is not a market entity. 'KSA' appears only in JS (HM_EMP_STOP), so no ctry.ksa id; NEOM and Qiddiya are employers/giga-projects (co.*), not cities.

Advisor languages 'AR · EN' / 'AR' (ADV.*.langs, stray bookType/advisor) must follow the market languages (FR markets 'FR · EN', DE 'DE · EN') -> lang.* partition. Advisor reply-time and slot strings ('Wed 19:00', 'Sun 17:00') and the BKSL canon assume Sun-Thu -> cal.* partition.

Code notes (JS): window.ADV (L10284-10306) and BKARN (L10464, no Nadia entry) hard-code advisor names/initials: read adv.*.full / adv.*.ini via MKT.ent. HM_EMP_STOP (L14331) stop-words 'Riyadh|Jeddah|Dammam|Saudi|KSA' must come from the target pack (city.*, ctry.dem). HM_PH (L14319-14325) only knows +966/05x shapes: a US 10-digit number without + or leading 0 (2025550123) or a 7700 900 123 style number would slip through, so build the regex from phone.cc + national pattern per residence. bkIcs (L10491) hard-codes UTC+3 (hh-3): needs the residence IANA zone/offset next to res.tz. SNB.city / sentCtxFor() / cities fallback (L11764) default to Riyadh / 'All of Saudi Arabia'.

Amounts in partition-B strings that are neither product prices nor monthly salaries: jpAnchor 'A human coach in Riyadh runs about 400 ¤' is a third-party market price compared with our 149 ¤ session -> {@$:400} (residence price conversion keeps the ratio honest). Employer facts inside *About blurbs: swc7About 'more than 500 billion dollars' (NEOM investment, USD), swc5About 'more than 300 square kilometers', swc6About 'more than 500 branches', swc1About 'more than 40,000 employees across the Gulf', swc8About 'more than 15 million shoppers across the Gulf', swh2About 'more than 70 destinations', swc10About 'millions of members' -> keep literal inside per-employer pack copy (they are facts about that employer, not convertible). Advisor stats (apBio 12 years, apHuBio 10 years, apKhBio/apNdBio 15 years, apOmBio eight years, apSaBio 20,000 CVs, ratings 4.7-5.0 with counts 34-203, apNdCnt 34 engagements) and testimonial percentages (apOmR1 18%, apNdR1 40%, rfReward 10% off) are market-neutral: keep literal. rcSeller VAT number 300012345600003 -> legal/tax id (residence). msaKnowList 'Offer from Tabby, 33,000' and 'Salary floor 26,000' have no currency and are monthly salaries -> {@saln:33000} / {@saln:26000} (and the period follows the target).

French: ctry.n/ctry.s/ctry.k carry the article (l'Arabie saoudite, le Royaume) because FR needs it mid-sentence; FR prepositions vary by country gender/number (en Arabie saoudite, au Qatar, aux Émirats, à Bahreïn), so FR copy should use {@ctry.in} rather than 'en {@ctry.n}'. FR elision/contraction after de/à (de l'Arabie saoudite, du Royaume-Uni, des Émirats) is not covered by any id: FR writers should rephrase around it or the packs need ctry.de ('d'Arabie saoudite', 'du Royaume-Uni') — suggested optional id. FR plural demonyms (saoudiens/saoudiennes) also have no id. Dr title: FR writes 'Dr' without a period (adv.nadia.full fr).

Gendered people: every ppl.* and adv.* id has a fixed gender because surrounding AR (and EN she/he) agrees with it (e.g. m1sr 'أخصائية الاستقطاب' for Danah, apHuBio 'She helps you'). Market packs must keep each id's gender. Testimonial reviewer names are paired with job titles in one string ("Reem, Financial Analyst" / "ريم، محللة مالية"): tokenize only the name ({@ppl.rv.reem}, Financial Analyst). Similar-looking ids are different people: ppl.danah (recruiter 'Danah Al-Sulaiman') vs ppl.rv.dana (reviewer 'Dana', same AR 'دانة'); ppl.ghadah vs ppl.rv.ghada (same AR 'غادة'); ppl.meshal vs ppl.rv.mishal (same AR 'مشعل'); ppl.ref 'Sara' (referred friend) vs adv.sara 'Sara' (advisor Sara Kanaan, same AR 'سارة').

Name collisions inside other entities: 'Abdullah' (ppl.rv.abdullah, apRn2 only) also occurs in 'King Abdullah Economic City' (city.kaec); 'Riyad' (Riyad Bank) is not 'Riyadh'; 'Dr.' also prefixes 'Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib' (co.*, swh7Co). Tokenize names only in the listed keys.

Demonym phrases kept as {@ctry.dem} + literal: msaIntro 'Saudi labour law' / 'نظام العمل السعودي', rtT1 'Knew the Saudi market', epR2/apR2/chT1 'Saudi panels', apHuBio 'Saudi HR teams', djSugT 'the Saudi finance ladder'. They read fine for most markets ('British labour law', 'the Emirati market'); if the legal partition defines a target-scope labour-law name id, msaIntro should use that instead (US 'US labor law', FR 'le Code du travail', EG 'قانون العمل المصري').

Pack alignment: SA.core.json people[] (10 names) does not cover the 29 people ids here (7 recruiters, 14 reviewers, 1 referral friend, 7 advisors) and lists 'Faisal Al-Qahtani' while v5 has advisor 'Faisal Al-Harbi' (adv.faisal.full keeps the v5 value). Packs need ~30 gendered names, or the market packs map ids explicitly. SA.core.json phone.ex '+966 55 123 4567' is international format; phone.loc is the national typed form '0551234567' (a different id on purpose).
